title: Statement of Architecture Work
body:
# Statement of Architecture Work — T9 TOGAF ADM capability (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Assignment

The assignment is to deliver the TOGAF ADM capability of SPEC_V2 §8.1, not a document set: the Preliminary capability and phases A–H as WBS nodes, each phase with its typed artefacts and a closing contract; a delivery design gate against a live contract; a compliance review at Phase G with one level and dated waivers; and a Phase-H review with exactly one typed outcome. The work is for the programme architect (`conveyor-e2e`), accepted by the Architecture Board (`conveyor-architecture-board`) and approved by `conveyor-approver` under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`.

## Scope

The scope is the eleven tables of SPEC_V2 §10.3, the 26 `architecture.*` actions of §10.4, the four contract kinds, the six compliance levels, the waiver register, the Board row, the nine-dimension maturity and seven-category skills assessments, the Architecture destination of §10.5 and the T9 seed rows. Out of scope: an ArchiMate editor or live metamodel, a diagram renderer, full TOGAF conformance, a portfolio optimiser, the T1 plan rows, the T3 PM job and T10's tranche reviews and benefits realization.

## Responsibilities

The programme architect performs the work and owns the artefacts and the repository. The Architecture Board approves the principles, the tailored profile, the Phase A–D artefacts and the delivery contract. The approver is a distinct identity from the requester; the PM job (T3) routes the phase gates but does not decide them.

## Acceptance criteria

Phase A closes when the Statement of Architecture Work is approved; each later phase closes when every artefact the profile marks mandatory for its phase and plateau is approved and its contract is live. A phase missing a mandatory artefact is refused and writes no contract. A delivery project without a live contract is refused at design. A compliance review records one level; a waiver names its owner and review date. The Phase-H review produces exactly one change or kata. The first four are proved by named tests; the fifth is partial (v1-p81-6 and the absent `a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate`).

## Contract

The contract is a `statement_of_architecture_work` row for project T9, created by this retrospective pass and approved by the Architecture Board; its body is this document and its version is 1. The delivery contract and the closure review are separate records. The record is retrospective and does not attest intent at the 2026-11-18 close.
